title: Feasibility-Guided Fair Adaptive Reinforcement Learning for Medicaid Care Management

contributions.purpose: 在离线 RL 中同时兼顾安全、公平与可部署适应性
contributions.mechanism: FCAF-RL:统一三项进展——扩散模型安全增强(限制在临床可行域)+ equalized-odds 公平正则(TPR/FPR 组间差惩罚)+ 部署期自适应策略切换(按滑窗实测差异切换不同公平权重策略)
contributions.evaluation: 留一州交叉验证,测试集急性事件率 8.5%(所有基线最低),达到收益-公平最佳平衡
contributions.domain: 医疗照护管理/离线强化学习/算法公平
contributions.source_quote: We introduce Feasibility-Guided Fair Adaptive Reinforcement Learning (FCAF-RL), an offline RL framework that unifies three recent advances—diffusion-based safety augmentation, equalised-odds fairness regularisation and adaptive policy switching—to learn safe and fair intervention policies from retrospective data.

contributions.purpose: 实证 FCAF-RL 相对现有方法的收益与公平提升
contributions.mechanism: 155,631 名 Medicaid 受益人周轨迹(WA/VA/OH),对比 6 个 SOTA 基线,加权 doubly-robust 离策评估
contributions.evaluation: 急性事件相对 risk-based 降 31.1%、相对 IQL 降 21%;公平差异 8.9→2.5 ppts;NNT 8.0→6.5;离策评估期望回报显著优于所有基线(p<0.01)
contributions.source_quote: FCAF-RL reduced acute events by 31% relative to a risk-based baseline and 21% relative to Implicit Q-Learning, while decreasing fairness disparities from 8.9 to 2.5 percentage points.

contributions.purpose: 在隐私约束下支持复现
contributions.mechanism: 开源 FCAF-RL 及全部基线代码,并用 Gaussian copula 生成保留边际/成对相关/时序结构的合成数据集替代不可共享的真实 Medicaid 数据
contributions.evaluation: 单张 A100(24 CPU/12GB)约 6 小时训练可复现;提供超参/种子/env
contributions.source_quote: We provide code and synthetic data to facilitate reproducibility.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We build upon FISOR and OGSRL to enforce feasibility and safety, FairDICE to incorporate fairness objectives, and CAPS to support adaptive deployment.

It begins by augmenting the offline dataset using a diffusion model similar to FISOR. ... Finally, following the constraint-adaptive policy switching (CAPS) framework we derive deterministic policies for each fairness weight.

notes: accept,本批质量最高。trade-off(消融带数字):NoFair 变体急性事件降幅略高(32.5% vs 全模型 31.1%)但公平差异近乎翻倍恶化(6.8 vs 2.5 ppts)——公平正则以极小的效果代价换来显著更公平;NoAug 与 NoSwitch 均劣于全模型。关键 caveat:31% 等降幅为回顾性数据上的离策(off-policy)估计而非前瞻性 RCT,作者自承所有 OPE 估计器依赖 overlap 假设可能有偏、存在未观测混杂/选择偏倚,NNT 置信区间因是风险差倒数而偏宽。AI 自我披露:系统为 'Waymark AI Data Scientist'(OpenAI GPT-5 核心推理+写作、Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet 二次综合),AI Involvement Checklist 五项均 C(AI 主导设计/分析/写作,人类 co-author Sanjay Basu 提供领域监督/协议校验/解释)。正面细节:附 'Corrected Reference Update' 页主动更正一处被标记的引用(Raghu et al.),表明做了引用核验(与 AS0038 幻觉引用形成对比)。self-declared provenance 清晰(build upon FISOR/OGSRL/FairDICE/CAPS)。
